tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// shāsanabhawauyunudayāmṛtan+nāmabaṭusid+dhikohastiprasarit+yaḥprok+tādud+dhṛtaṃshasturmatot+pādas+yanāmakārapariṇamash+tsapraṇidhesh+tsagāthābidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// mkhas grub klong chen rab 'byams pa'i gsung rab las phyung pa'i bstan bcos kyi phyi mo bskrun pa'i par byang dang yongs su bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa bstan srid lang tsho bdo ba'i zil mngar bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i pṛt+ta yi ge bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags las nye bar bskyed pa bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi grangs mnyam las blangs pa'i prāstā ras rnam par brgyan pa'o// ༄༅// sar+b+baṃdzinānāṃtriyabhāwaguh+yāḥ dhiṣ+ṭhānabhagyang+shuradzebhirup+taḥ kalpam+mahāshaṃsahadzār+hasādh+yaḥ k+ṣaṇodayashrīguruhīdzayan+tu// ༄༅// rgyal bai dharba'i mdzes pa'i yon tan gtam la sbyar ba/ ba kun dngos gang gi gsang gsum gyi// byin rlabs 'od rdul gyis btab skal ba can// bskal par bsgrub 'os lhan skyes bde ba che// skad cig 'char ba dpal ldan bla ma rgyal// gang yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa la gzugs can gyis spud pa/ gi rang bzhin gdod nas ka dag rnam kun mchog las gzhar yang 'pho med kun tu bzang*// dpag yas bsod nams pir gyi rtser 'khrungs mtshan dpe lham mer chos mchog 'gag med rnam snang mdzad// bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing gi 'gror snang gang 'tsham legs gsungs zil dngar yongs 'jo shākya'i tog /ngo bo gcig nyid tha dad zhing 'char sku gsum ston pas bsams kun grub pa'i me tog stsol// phreng ba'i gsal byed las drangs pa/ mtha' med srid las nges par 'byin byed nges 'byung blo ste de nyid kyis bskul mngon mtho dang*// nges legs bskrun pa'i thabs kyi khyad par ci yang lhur byed thabs lam kun gzhi sdom pa ste// sdom brtson yongs kyi skyed byed gang zhig skyabs su yong ye bzung ba nyid las gzhan gyis min// der bsten thabs kyi khyad par bslabs rnams 'dod pa'i dpal ster dkon mchog rnam gsum bden dpang spyon// grangs med skye rig byed pa'i gtam las drangs pa'i bsdus dang ma bsdus gzugs can/

ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam dwangs ma mtha' dag 'dab stong sbubs su gcig 'khyil ba// ngo mtshar grub pa'i lang tsho dar bab rgyal kun ma 'dus med pa'i zhal skyin 'jo sgeg 'phrul// gdul dka'i mi srun me zhal tshogs kyi brtan pa rab phrogs chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde'i// bdud rtsi'i dga' ston ris bral 'gyed pa mtsho skyes rdo rjes brjod don snying pos lci bar mdzod// ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can la mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi dpes spras pa/ deng 'dir ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i khyung sngon skyes kyi rnam par dpyod pa'i shing rtar brten// rmad byung legs par bshad pa'i 'od kyi pho nya dang 'grogs snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'od brgya pa// lus can bsod nams yangs pa'i mkha' dkyil mkhas tshul gsum gyis 'tsho gzhes brtan pa'i cho ga mkhan// tshulaṃ khrimaṃs gsum dang rigs lung rab 'byams smra ba'i bloṃ groṃs phyogs kyi glaṃng po cheṃn po'i mched// gang gis rig byed pa'i lo rgyus las drangs pa'i bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs/ legs gsungs gting mthas rnam dben chu yi gter// gzhan phan sems kyi sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs las skyes// dran dbang rnam gsum gnon pa'i rtsal gyis nye bar blangs// khol bur phyung ba'i bstan bcos rga shi 'joms pa'i sman// skal ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ pa bzang po'i ngag gi mtshon can gzhon nu dag /chos rab 'byed pa'i 'dren byed 'dzums pa med bltas pas// thog mtha' bar gyi gnas skabs gsum gar dge ba'i chos// byang chub snying po'i srog rtsa brling ster bcud kyi len// mdo sh+lau ka gnyis rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba'i rigs/ sngags bzhed pa bkrag tu che ba ri dwags rtags// kun mkhyen mig stong ldan pa'i mdzub rtser 'khrungs gyur pa// mdzod sde bdun dang ngal gso rnam gsum rtsa 'grel dang*// bsdus don gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi rnam 'grel bcas// blo mchog skye bos bsten par 'os pa'i dbyig 'dzin ma// mun khrod chu gter chen por byings kyis dogs pa yis// mchog gi sprul sku'i thugs bskyed mi dman sred med bu// khab spu ldan pa'i 'jug pa la brten 'degs la zhugs// brda

mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa'i dpe rgyan/ skyon bgrungs pa'i bstan bcos phyi mo gcig cig bskrun// de nyid nas brtsams bskal pa'i phreng bar chos 'byung ba// kun phan dkyil 'khor gcig las che chung chu snod grangs// gzugs brnyan ston pa'i ngo mtshar rjes su rkang pa 'jog /bsgrub nang shes byed kyi rgyu/ dka'i las kyi rang zhal bstan pas phyir phyogs min// gtong ba rmad byung thabs kyis bshol yang ldog min par// dam pa rnams ni g.yar dam bcas pa mthar son pa'i// grags pa'i zla ris phyogs bral nub pa med la dga'// legs rab brtag las ting nge 'dzin/ byas gang phyir gtong ba che dang sbyor ba thabs// brtsams tshul rdzogs par gtam du gleng ba'i 'phrin yig khur// theg gam ma yin 'phyang mo nyug gi dpyangs thag la// 'khyud pa'i 'od srungs byin yang ring zhig yam mor 'dar// 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa/ chos la las byas dge tshogs tha gru rab yangs pa'i// pha rol bsam brjod yul las bskal pa'i rgya che gang*// byang chub chen por yongs su bsgyur min de srid du// rtag par 'phel min bri zhing gtugs pa'i gzhan dbang 'gyur// ldan pa'i gzugs can/ 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das kyis bsags dgeṃ baṃ'i klung*// ji snyed spro ba rmad byung rnam dkar dgeṃ baṃ 'dir// thabs la ma rmongs blo yi byed pos gcig tu bsdoms// byaṃng chuṃb mchoṃg gi dag byed gter du gzhol phyir bsngoṃ// chags pa med par ris bral 'gro grags ma grags gnyis ka rgyu bzlog nas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo ston pa'i srid pa can/ la phan bde ster// sdang sems min par sgrib gsum lhag ma med par za// bcol ba med par gang gis bsten la ci 'dod stsol// gsaṃr rnyingaṃ bstaṃn paṃr yi ge'i grags 'bar rgyas gyur cig /su rgyu'i rgyan/ zhig mnyan bsam shes bya kun gyi gnas tshul rig

/sngon med rnam 'byed blo gros zung gi lang tsho bskyed// nyams bstar lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ci yang 'phel// 'chosaṃ skyobaṃ leṃgs paṃr bshaṃd 'diṃs 'jig rten khyab gyur cig /bskal dpe rgyan las nges pa'i dpe/ pa bzang po'i dpaṃl ldaṃn thub pa'i choṃs tshul skyongaṃ*// gang zhig phyogs bral sems can sman 'dogs rnam par thar// dus gsum bde gshegs mdzad pa min pa khams gsum na// mtshungs dpes dben gang brgya phrag bskal par 'tsho gzhes shog /ngag gi mi ldan pa'i gzugs can/ dbang phyug mkhyen brtse'i mdzub rtse zung sbyar bas// lung rigs 'chad pa'i mchu 'dab rab tu snyung byas pa'i// dpaṃl stugaṃ bstanaṃ paṃ'i snaṃng byedaṃ chen po gang dag mchis// gsang gsum zho 'thungs rus pa'i rdo rjer grub gyur cig /rnam rgya che ba'i rgyan las bsam pa rgya che/ kun mchog gi bde sku 'gyuraṃ meṃd rtag gzhes kyang*// smon lam 'gag pa min pa'i rang gdangs sprul pa'i sku// thegaṃ mchogaṃ bstaṃn pa'i bshad sgrub sgra dbyangs srid pa'i rtser// lud pa de srid yongs 'dziṃn rdo rje gsum du brtan// bsdus dang ma bsdus 'dres pa'i gzugs can/ nam zhig byang chub snye ma gser du ma smin pa// de srid skye ba'i dzam+bū bṛk+ṣa lung rtogs kyi// yon tan ro bda'i 'bras bu 'dzad med g.yur za ba// lus can yongs kyi nyer 'tsho bla med nyid gyur cig /paṃd+mā rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ ka ra las brgyud gsaṃng ba sngagaṃs kyis mtshon// dam pa'i chos mdzod yang dag 'dzin mchog sprul pa'i sku// gtsug lag rab 'byams gser mngal bu mo dgyes pa'i glur// rtag par 'jo yin byams bstan ma shar bar du brling*// nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims nyes med yan lag gcig gzugs/ gsung zhim 'thul// klog dang spong ba'i 'khor lo lhur ler 'duṃs tshoṃgs kyi// bla gos sin+dhū wā ra gzhon nu'i tshon mdangs dag

/phyoṃgs kyi lus phra'i mkhur tshos khyaṃb par spud gyur cig /legs gsungs mtha' dag gzugs can/ chos tshul sde tshan dpag yas khur gyis mdzes// mi bdag khyad nor bdun gyi sdeṃ yi yon tan rdzogs// thar pa'i grong khyer lhod por bgrod pa'i gom stabs bde// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor lus stobs brtas pa'i gnyis 'thung bdag /sngon bsags dgeṃ tshogs gtam rgyud las drangs pa'i mtha' dag gzugs/ bden tshig grub pa'i drang srong gis// yid srubs bar chad lha min spun gyi ngan g.yo bcil// bloṃ groṃs gsus pa rnam par yangs bar chos srid kyi// dge legs chu klung rgyaṃ mtshoṃ 'khyil ba rgyal gyur cig / bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ mi dman bsoṃd namaṃs cha shas kun nas yongs gang ba'i// rgyal phran gnyis skyes bye bas thal sbyar spyi bos btud// chos ldan mi bdag rgyu skar mgoṃn poṃ gang yin de// mi shigs nor bu'i khri la rtag par 'tsho gyur cig /choṃs gcig la gcig ltos kyi rab spel/ srid dpal 'byor ri gling chu gter ma lus pa// dbang sgyur mkhyen dpyod gser gyi tsakra sngon 'gro bas// 'dzam gling skye bo yongs su skyongaṃ ba'i dpal mgoṃn du// sku tshe phrin las nga las nu 'dra nyid gyur cig /nor gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ 'dzin bu mo'i mtshar sdug 'dab stong dkyil 'khor la// mkha' mnyam yid can bus pa'i rkang pa drug ldan rnams// dge spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan sbrang rtsis cher myos pa'i// bde skyid rtse 'jor rol pa'i 'phur lding bsgyur bar shog /yid 'ong sprin sngon dag byed zegs ma ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan/ dus su 'thor// gser ldan dga' ba'i 'gyur ba sngo bsangs lang tsho ngom// dbyar skyes rtsi shing lo tog 'bras bu dar bab kyi// ya mtshan ltad mo phan tshun ci yang ston par shog /tshul dang po gsum par yod pa chad pa'i zung ldan/

'dir do dam 'dri zhus las kyi 'brel thogs rnams// byang chub bar gyi skye bar bco brgyad chos ldan rten// tshul chen thos bsam bsgoms pa las byung shes rab kyis// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i chos la bya ba byed par shog /snyom las pa yang tshe rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ rabs phreng bar lus med thul// mchog gi bstan la bla ma lha yis rjes bzung nas// gtsug lag rab 'byams yang dag rig pa'i 'od stong gis// sa gsum chos kyi snang chen 'gyed pa nyid gyur cig /de gzugs can las ldan pa'i gzugs can/ skad mchid pa lhag bsam rnam par gnag pa min pa'i zhing sa shin tu gshin pa la// gnas skabs mthar thug phun tshogs ston dus g.yur du za rung mngon 'dod 'bras bur smon pa'i lam// sa bon rma med ci rigs btab pa dkon mchog thugs rje yol ba min pa'i drod gsher gyi// rnam pa thams cad phun tshogs snye mas stongs pa min par skal ba sbom pos srungs shig gu// zhes gsar rnying ris bral gyi bstan pa dri bral du skyong zhing 'chad pa la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i mkhas grub dbang po rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin pa dang*/ dpal stobs kyi dbang phyug sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa mchod yon nas/ smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po klong chen rab 'byams pa'am/ mtshan dngos tshul khrims blo gros zhes grags pa'i gsung rab las/ khol bur phyung ba'i bstan bcos mdzod bdun rtsa 'grel bsdus don du bcas pa/ ngal gso skor gsum rtsa 'grel bsdus don du bcas pa/ gsang ba'i snying po'i rgyud kyi rnam 'grel bcas rnams rnying bstan yongs kyi bstan bcos kyi mig lta bur dgongs nas chos sbyin 'dzad pa med pa'i rgyun gyi phyi mo bskrun par mdzad pa'i par byang dang yongs su bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa bstan srid lang tsho bdo ba'i zil dngar zhes bya ba 'di ni/

sprul pa'i sku rin po che de nyid kyi bka' stsal gan+dharba'i gling bu'i spun zla dag gis phebs par brten/ gangs can ljongs pa'i gsung rab kyi brda gsar rnying dag la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa'i dag byed pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags med du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i na tshod ldan zhes pa'i gnam lo'i zhag gi phung po rgyu skar khrums stod kyis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa/ legs bris kyi bden tshig grub pa'i drang srong chen po ṛ ṣis/ dag byed nyal 'gro ma'i rgyun thams cad yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i dus ston bzang po la lus can mtha' dag mgron gnyer ba'i dus tshes dge bar 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i rgyun chen po dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs/ ldan yul chos sder grags pa'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba dang nye bar 'brel pa'i dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum pa'i pho brang du sbyar ba dge legs rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// //swasti bi dza yan+tu// dpag yas bskal pa'i sngon nas byang chub kyi// snying po bla na med pa mngon bgyis kyang*// mon lam rjes dran mdzad pa bsam yas kyis// 'gro ba 'dul mchog nyi ma'i gnyen la 'dud// gang des 'gro khams dbang por 'tsham pa'i chos// dman mchog theg pa'i bdud rtsi bsam mi khyab// stsal ba'i snying po nges don ston pa'i mdo// zung gis lhag pa'i bcu phrag gnyis dag ni// yi ge'i rnam par 'khrungs sam glegs bam byin// bklags sam thos sogs brtson pa'i bsod nams tshad// legs bris lam gyis gzhal yang mtshon min pas// blo gros dad gsum lam du nyer drangs pa// skyes sbyangs stobs kyi byed pos shes rab mig

/rgya chen chos kyi yul la dkyus bsrings pa'i// rigaṃ pa 'dziṃn pa'i dbang phyug tsheṃ yi dbaṃng*// noṃr buṃ'i dpal gyi yi ge'i gling bu snyan// gang des nges don bstan pa ring 'tsho zhing*// 'gro tshogs nges legs lam du gzud phyir dang*// byang chub spyod pa rmad byung chu yi gter// bla nas bla mar 'phel ba'i legs byas su// yi ge'i gzugs su bstar ba'i rgyu rkyen dag /phun tshogs legs par sbyar te de yi rgyun// chos sbyin 'dzad med 'dod pa 'jo byed pa// ngo mtshar par gyi ma mo bskrun ched du// gtsug lag rab 'byams 'chad la mkhas pa'i mthu// 'jam dpal gzhon nus legs byin ngag gi dbang*// grub pa si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes// mi bdag rigs kyi cod paṇa de las brgyud// ma hā bho ṭa'i nor 'dzin thig le ru// sde bzhi'i dpal ldan dge ba'i rgyal thabs che// las shugs btsan po'i dpung pas skyong ba po// bla chen kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sder// mtsho byung dges pa'i gtam gyi mdzub rtse yis// rig sngags 'chang ba rdo rje'i slob dpon de'i// bzhed don snying po par du 'god pa'i bka'// 'phrin yig snyan pa'i rgyud mangs ci yang brdungs// de don de ltar zhal 'ches mi bdag gis// legs byas legs pa'i dpal 'byung phyi mo 'di// chos ldan chos kyi 'dun sa lhun grub steng*// rgyal khab rgyal ba'i myu gu'i gnas su bskrun// legs byas skya rengs gzhon nus mdun bsu ba'i// rgyal bstan nyi ma 'od brgya 'bar ba dang*// bstan 'dzin pad+ma bzhad pa'i nags khrod nas// bshad sgrub bung ba'i dbyangs snyan len par shog /rgyal bstan dgung du 'degs brtson mi bdag gi /sku tshe bsod nams stobs 'byor ma lus pa// 'chi med yul gyi bdag po'i phun tshogs rnams// 'di na yongs su 'phos bzhin dar gyur cig /dkon mchog thugs rje yangs pa'i gdugs dkar po// srid pa'i gdung skyob g.yo ba'i grib bsil du// chab 'bangs kyis mtshon 'dzam gling skye 'gro rnams// bde 'byor dge ba'i zil mngar 'thung bar shog

/de ltar nges don snying po ston pa'i mdo sde'i chos kyi rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ kā li'i grangs dang mnyam ched chos tshan brgyad kyi kha 'gengs dang bcas pa 'di dag gzhan la sman pa'i thugs can ka thog rig 'dzin chen po nas yi ger 'drir bcug ste/ slar dam pa de nyid dang si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas pa lhan cig pas/ mdo khams phyogs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sde dge sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes grags pa'i sku mdun du/ 'di dag par du 'god pa'i gsung bskul gyi bka' nan dngos rdzas kyi rten dang bcas te phul bar brten/ rab myos kyi lor chos sbyin par du bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ par byang nyung ngu 'di ni zhu dag pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu gleng ba sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ bdag tu 'dzin pas dben pa'i chos kyi spyan// yangs pa'i pha rol phyin mchog mkha' 'gro mas// mngon par sprul pa'i gzhal med khang pa na// dbang bskur sa drug mnan pa bi rū pa// mgon po de yis skal bar ldan pa'i ngor// legs par gdams pa'i gsung ngag rin chen zhes// dus gsum rgyal ba kun kyang lam 'di la// ma brten gang du phyin par med pa'i chos// tshul 'di gangs ri'i ljongs su dar ba'i las// bgyid pa'i g.yar dam bcas te pad dkar 'chang*// mi yi srid par 'phos la sa skya par// grags pa'i rnga chen phyogs kyi mkhas pas brdungs// de nyid sras dang bcas pa'i phrin las rgyun// yongs su bzung nas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i las// dri med smra ba de ni khyod nyid ces// thub pa'i lung gis bsngags pa kun dga' bzang*// des ni sngon chad rgyal ba mang pos kyang*// bsgral bar ma bzod 'gro ba ji snyed cig /dam pa'i chos 'di'i snod du bkug nas ni// smin grol thabs kyi dga' ston ci yang stsal// de rjes dam pa'i chos kun snyan ngag gi

/glu ru len la smra ba'i rgyal po zhig /sa stengs na ni dkoṃn pa'i mchoṃg gyur pa// yon tan thams cad lhunaṃ gyis gruṃb pa byung*// des ni khrid gzhung rgyas pa gzhung bzhin du// bkri ba'i sngon 'gro snang ba rnam gsum dang*// dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gnyis ka go bde ru// mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyis bklubs par byas// tshul 'di nyams su bzhes dang gzhan dag la// sbyin par bya ba'i chos su 'chang ba po// rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal ldan chos skyong gis// par du sgrubs pa'i grogs su rnam par bskul// de tshe sdeṃ bzhi rgyas pa'i rgyal srid gang*// dgeṃ ba'i las kyis skyong ba'i bla ma che// kunaṃ dgaṃ' phriṃn laṃs rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i sde zhes pas// bka' don bsgrub par zhal gyis 'ches bzhin du// gtsug lag lugs brgya'i mdun sa lhun grub steng*// rgyal khab mthun pa min pa'i phyogs kun las// rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyogs ba gam du// mi zad chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo chen phye// dge bas chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa'i// lugs bzang 'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs rims// 'joms byed sman gyi rgyal po 'dra ba 'di// 'jig rten khams su rtag par gnas gyur cig /de yi phrin las gser gyi 'khor lo yis// sa stengs 'gro ba mnga' mdzad e waṃ pa'i// lung rtogs bstan pa dri ma med pa gang*// 'jig rten khams su gsal bar snang gyur cig /dpaṃl ldanaṃ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dbang phyug gi /lung dang rtogs pa'i choṃs tshul dri ma med// rnam gsum mkhas pa'i bya bas skyongaṃ ba po// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i rgyan du brtan gyur cig /thub pa'i lugs bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i grong*// mi nub brtan par 'degs pa'i phrin las can// sdom brtson skye dgu'i bdag po'i sa 'dzin 'di// chab srid rgya mtsho'i dpal du brtan gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub mchog gi bar// sde snod gsum dang gsang rgyud ma lus pa'i// bstan pa rin chen sgron me legs bzung nas// khams gsum chos kyi snang bas 'gengs par shog

/ces gsung ngag rin po che'i chos sbyin par gyi 'phrul sgo phye ba'i par byang nyung ngu 'di yang chos 'di la mos pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa datra/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// // ༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'jamaṃ mgoṃn mkhyen pa'i chu gter las// gang 'dul sprul pa'i bkraṃ shiṃs dung*// zab rgyas chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun// 'gag med lhuṃn gruṃb zhabs kyis skyongs// chos dbyings spros pa'i sgrib bral ngang las smon lam rjes dgongs dri bzhon gyis// mngon par bskul ba'i thugs rje'i sprul gzugs mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyi ri bong 'dzin// bsam yas phrin las bsil zer thigs pas ngan song duḥkha'i tsha gdung phrogs// phan dang bde ba'i ku mud dgod mdzad rgyal ba rnam snang bsil sbyin mkhan// ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba la// rjes su chags tshon dmar pos mchu yi sgros// lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i khong nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs// snyan pos gdams pa'i yang snying rdo rje'i theg /thabs shes dbyer med nyams len yo ga yi// nang tshan cha mthun rgyud las ngan song sgrib// sbyong la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gang*// bsngags brjod rol mos 'jig rten dog por byas// shes rlom tshangs pa'i bka' nyan ma byas shing*// sgros ngan khyab 'jug rkang pa'i dri ma med// rtog ge drang srong kha yi ngan skyugs dang*// 'grogs pa'i skyon med cho ga gaṅgā'i klung*// ston dang paṇa grub lo tsā'i phreng rim gyi// thugs kyi lam lung nas brgyud sa skya pa'i// 'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i gser ldan yangs pa'i phang*// thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam byed rgya mtshor bskyil// gang gsung rdo rje'i tshig gi chab rom rgyas// bcings pa bzhu khams gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi// lag len rgyun gtsang bsgyur la mi 'jigs pa'i// mkhyen yangs nyin mo'i mgon de gang zhe na// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i don phyir dus gsum gyi// bde gshegs kuṃn gyi mkhyen brtse spobs pa gzungs// gcig tu legs bsdoms mkhas rnams dga'aṃ ba'i bshes// bzaṃng poṃr sprul pa'i skyes chen nyid las su// grangs med skye bar bsags pa'i las nyon stobs// skad cig gcig gis nyams byed cho ga'i 'phrul// byed po gang gi sku drin phrag pa na// thegs dka'i dogs pas sa 'di rnam drug 'dar// des gsungs dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsnyen pa dang*// cho ga cha gsum gtor ma phyag chen bcas// gzhan yang sbyin sreg dbang gi mtshams sbyor dang*// phan yon ro sreg nyer mkho rab gnas gnyis// de dag phyi mo re las du ma'i gzugs// bskal mang 'byung ba'i mig 'phrul 'di mthong tshe// ma dag rgyun 'byams skyengs pa'i gdong dman la// ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs khrel dgod dam snyam// gang 'di sprul pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i tog

/zhing 'dir gzigs pa rnam lngas sgyu 'phrul ma'i// sras kyi tshul bzung sa 'brug lor bltams nas// sum stong dgu brgya zhe dgu brgal ba'i dus// dmar ser lo yi ka shī mdzes dga' mas// sum ldan 'byung ba'i rgyan gos gsar pa'i chas// bsgyur te dpyid kyi bshul ring zhugs nas brtsams// dbyar dang ston gyi dus ston spyod pa'i ring*// phun tshogs sdeṃ bzhi'i 'byor tshogs phan tshun dag /'gran zlar byed la yul gyi dgeṃ bcu yang*// blta phyir lhags pa'i rgyal khab bkod legs gtam// phyogs kyi 'khyams pos brkus te ring du bros// de na chos kyis mtho ba'i sa spyod ni// bsags la mngon zhen skud pas ma btsems shing*// bsgrub dka'i las kyi rang zhal bstan pas kyang*// gtong phod dge ba'i brtan pa dbrog nus min// chos sbyin spel la spro bas drangs pa'i thugs// gzhan dag phan pa'i ched yin rang don min// chen po'i gtong phod bstan pa'i phyir yin gyi// srid pa'i khe grags 'dod nas min pas 'tsheng*// yang srid mang por dge la goms pa rnams// legs pa'i lam la phyir zhing spro ba 'phel// sngon bsags las kyi rgyu mthun 'bras bu'i mtha'// btsan pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bden gtam gshis// grogs dag gdung ba phrogs nas gang 'dod kyi// 'bras bu ris med 'gro la sbyin nges pa'i// cho ga'i dpag bsam rkang 'thung thob nas ding*// thob shor yongs 'du phal la re ba thong*// tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge dang dus gsum gyi// legs byas blo yis gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus// mngon par mtho dang nges legs dpal 'byung gzhi// rgyal ba'i lugs mchog yun du rgyas byed shog /rnam 'dren rang gis legs par bzhag pa'i srol// rnam dag smra mkhas de ni khyod gcig ces// rnam mang lung gis bstan gyur e waṃ pa'i// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen lam dar gyur cig /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khang par lha mi spyi'i// bsod nams rkang mgyogs grub pas khugs pa'i mgron// bsten na bkraṃ shiṃs don gnyis lhuṃn gruṃb lam// 'phyugs med ston pa'i zhabs pad brtan par shog

/dpal gyi sdeṃ bzhin dgeṃ ba'i snying stobs kyis// rgyal bstanaṃ bla na 'degs bzod sa yi bdag /rigs sras bcas paṃ sku tsheṃ chos srid dpal// riṃng 'tsho byang chub snying pos lci bar shog /kun 'byung las rlung dbang gis btsan pa des// sdug bsngal gcong rong bskyur ba'i 'gro ba spyi// dkon mchog thugs rje'i rin chen dpyang thag la// dam 'khyud nges par legs pa'i lam 'jug shog /rgyu sbyor gong gnyer zhu dang 'dri brkos kyi// las 'brel chab kyi thigs pa sbreng dgu rnams// gzhan don byang chub rgya mtsho smin gyur te// rnam 'phrul rin chen grangs med 'gyed par shog /de lta'i 'dod don smon pa bdag ni rdo rje'i ngag tu grub pa min// drang srong bden smra'i tshig gi mtshon cha stor ba rnyed pa'ang ma yin mod// dkon mchog byin rlabs dge ba'i mthu nus lhag bsam bskyed pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi// rten 'brel zab mo'i bden pa de yis gang smon don med ma gyur cig /de ltar stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i sde dge sa spyod chen po nyid nas/ grwa rigs thams cad la phan pa'i ched du tshogs 'don gyi chos spyod/ rgyud 'don/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha phal mo che rnams kyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog gtor chog mchod chog bstod pa/ zur 'debs/ bsnyen thabs/ sbyin sreg rab gnas/ bskang gso/ rnam bshad kyi rigs 'ga' re sogs nye bar mkho ba'i phyi mo sngar yod pa mi gsal ba rnams brje ba dang*/ med pa gsar du bskrun pa la sogs pa'i chos sbyin mi zad rgyun gyi phyi mo'i 'phrul sgo brgya phrag cig car du 'byed pa'i skabs su/ kun rig gi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa 'di nyid kyang gsar bskrun grub pa'i par byang bsngo smon gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang*/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis pa'i 'dren mchog bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa'i sgro btags pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel//

//na mo gu ra we/ grangs med bskal pa thog ma'i dga' tshal du// thugs bskyed sa bon btab pa las byung ba'i// phan bde'i snye ma mi zad 'byung ba'i dpyid// don kun grub pa'i dpag bsam ljon par 'dud// gang thugs gtsug tor rnam par lta ba yi// ting 'dzin nam mkha'i mdzod sgo 'byed pa'i tshe// sdug bsngal de rgyus gdungs pa'i sems can rnams// skyob par nges pa'i gdugs dkar can gyi gzungs// smra ba'i ro 'dzin med pa'i gtsug tor las// mgrin nas 'phos pa min pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis// tshig gi 'byung sgo bral yang srid dang zhi'i// rgud pa sel ba'i gzungs mchog mngon par bsgrags// de tshe mtha' yas zhing gi rgyal ba kun// gsung dbyangs yan lag rdzogs pa'i gdangs gcig gis// su zhig gzungs 'di thos pa'i bsod nams la// bsngags pa'i gling bus phyogs kun dog por byas// sangs rgyas rnams ni thugs bskyed thog ma nas// rdzun 'khyal ngag gi nyes pa yongs spangs pas// de phyir drang dang nges pas gang gsungs bka'// bden pas bslus pa'i gtam ni 'jig rten dkon// gang zhig thos na dad pa'i zhing sa gshin// bsams na dga' ba'i myu gu ci yang 'phel// bsgoms na rtogs pa'i lo thog legs pa'i phyir// thog mtha' bar dge'i khyad par brjod mi lang*// de dag yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa sogs// chos spyod dge ba bsgrubs pa'i phan yon gyi// sgra brnyan lung gi dbang po'i me na kas// lan brgyar brdungs pa'i tshig gis snying la bskul// gang tshe 'tsho byed 'dzin pa lhunaṃ grubaṃ kyis// chos sbyin zad mi shes pa'i ma mo 'di// sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa zhes// grags pa'i rnga chen ldir ba'i gnas su bskrun// phyi mo gcig las du ma 'byung ba'i 'phrul// 'di 'dra sngon chad ma myong 'gyod pa yis// sna tshogs las de gnyid la ma yur ba'i// mtshang dag mig mi 'dzums pa'i zol gyis bsgribs// tshul 'dir 'bad pa las byung dge ba dang*// 'phags dang so skyes bsags pa'i legs byas ni// ji snyed blo yi lag pa skad cig ma'i// stang stabs bsgyur ba'i rnam pas gcig tu bsdoms// 'di nas pha rol song ba dmigs pa'i yul// bsam 'grub ces bya'i rgyud la dge ba'i mthu// 'phos pa'i mod la lam lnga mthar phyin nas// bde ldan zhing gi pad+mar skye bar shog

/re zhig smon pa'i gnas der sngon las kyi// kha los drang ba'i skal ba phra na yang*// de srid dal ba 'byor pa'i rten bzung nas// tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom la 'dun par shog /bgrang las 'das pa'i lus can bh+ra ma ra// dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i rgyun// lung rtogs lang tsho rgyas pa'i bcud 'thung zhing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'dab mnyen bsgyur bar shog /ces pa'i par byang gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni lcags sprel gyi lor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu// //swasti bi dza yan+tu/ kun bzang 'od mtha' yas pa chos kyi sku// thugs rje'i rang rtsal ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs// mtsho skyes ge sar las 'khrungs sprul pa'i sku// rnam gsum byang chub bar du spyi bos mchod// rgyal kun thugs rje'i chu gter che las skyes// byin rlabs nus pa'i cha shas yongs gang zla// cher snyigs lnga bdo'i 'gro blo'i chu snod grangs// legs shar don mdzad pad+ma sam+bha waḥ// rtsa gsum yongs 'dus dbang gi rgyal po la// ji ltar mngon 'dod gsol btab 'bras bu'i dpyid// bslu med lag rtser stsol ba yid ches kyi// bzhin ras mkhyen pa'i me long ci yang bkra// gang tshe sprul pa'i rje blon 'bangs la sogs// ma 'ongs sems can phan phyir thugs bskyed grus// byin rlabs thugs rje'i rgya mtsho brgal ba las// nyer thob gsol ba gdab tshul yid bzhin nor// 'byung 'gyur skal dman dbul ba bsal slad du// zab chos rin chen gter du sbas pa las// nyer byon dbus gyur 'chang gi phyi mo'i rgyun// dpyad gsum dag pa'i yid ches sarga bdun// skal ba bzang ldan skye bo gang dag gis// gsol gdab dbyangs bdun 'khrol ba'i g.yar lam du// mtsho skyes rdzu 'phrul bgrod pa mi 'gog par// bsam kun rdzogs byed thugs rje yangs pa'i gshis// khyad par lha srin 'byung po khros pa'i khas// nad yams bkres rngabs 'thab rtsod dus min du// 'tsho bral skal ba ngan pa'i na bun rlangs// ches cher gtul ba rtsod dus tha ma 'dir// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs rje nyer bskul ba'i// gsol btab bdud rtsi'i thigs pas bran pa'i 'phral// thams cad nyer zhi'i bde ba ster nges pa// 'di mthong gzhan du 'tshol la gus pa lhod// kun slong de nyid kyis drangs chos sbyin rgyun// mi chad gcig las du ma 'byung ba'i 'phrul// 'di ko o rgyan rab dga'i gus sbyor gyis// dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bskrun// rnam dkar dge ba'i shing rtas dkon mchog gi

/byin rlabs nyin mor byed pa'i 'od stong gis// bstan 'gro'i mi mthun mun pa nyer bcil te// bkra shis 'dab brgya phyogs bral rgyas gyur cig /dge bcur legs spyod dpyid kyi dpal mo yis// 'jig rten bde skyid phun tshogs dbyar gyi mdza'// mgron du gnyer ba'i bde 'byor dga' ston la// ris bral 'gro bas longs su spyod gyur cig /sbyin bdag ltos bcas 'di nas byang chub bar// rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla mas rjes bzung nas// zab lam thos bsam bsgom pa mthar phyin nas// bde gshegs bstan pa kun du snang byed shog /ces au ḍ+yān gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa le'u bdun pa par du bsgrubs pa'i bsngo byang 'di ni o rgyan rab dga'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ phyogs dang phyogs bral mu mthas dben pa'i zhing*// 'gro la ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i spyan// gzhar yang 'dzum pa mi mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas// thams cad smon lam grub pa'i dpang por spyon// gang la brten nas bla med go 'phang bar// blang dor shes bya'i gnas kun gsal bar ston// thos bsam bsgom pa'i thog mtha' bar dge ba// lung rtogs chos kyi bden pas byin gyis rlobs// srid par sems can sman par lhur len yang*// srid pa'i skyon bral rnam 'dren bstan pa'i dpal// rgyal ba'i myu gu slob ma rkyen gcig rtogs// bstan srung nor sbyin tshogs 'dir grogs su spyon// deng 'dir gzhan don bla med byang chub sems// rmad byung bskyed pa'i shing rtar legs zhugs pa// gcod pa bkra shis sangs rgyas bstan srung dang*// chos skyong dar rgyas zhes bya'i sbyin bdag gis// rgyal dang rgyal sras zhi khro bgrang yas kyi// sku brnyan phreng ba bskrun dang thub mchog bka'// bod du 'gyur dgus nyer mtshon rten gsum rigs// bsod nams zhing bskrun mchod pas mdun nas bdar// lam mchog thos bsams bsgoms byung dge ba dang*// dkon mchog mchod dang mgon med sbyin gtong sogs// thams cad skye bo sdug bsngal chu gter las// yongs sgrol thub pa'i ded dpon 'grub rgyur bsngo// de thob bar gyi skye nas skye ba'i phreng*// srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob nges dkon mchog gsum// mi 'bral skyabs su thob pa'i smon lam ni// skud pas btsems bzhin rgyun chags 'brel gyur cig

/rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod che// khams gsum srid pa'i duḥkhas yid skyo nas// sgo gsum bag yod rwa bar gnas bcas te// sdig spong dge ba sgrub la brtson par shog /rang don zhi bde'i mching bu mi bsgrubs shing*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub mchog dbang gi rgyal// nges par ster nus theg mchog spyod mtsho che// brgal ba'i snying stobs gru chen bskyod par shog /kun rtog rdul gyi rgyal mtshan 'tshubs ma yis// rnam par dben pa rtse gcig ting nge 'dzin// mar me rtse yi gsal snang khyad par can// lam kun yon tan bskyed pa'i gzhir gyur cig /'khor 'das snang ba 'di kun rang gi sems// sems snang sna tshogs 'char ba rten 'brel gshis// gshis lugs dpyad ngor yod med yin min gyi// gyi nas dben pa'i lta ba rtogs par shog /sbyin bzhi'i phyag gi dpag bsam yal ga dag /rtag par rkyong ba la sogs pha rol tu// phyin drug lam dang bsdu bzhi'i gom stabs kyis// dpag yas spyod pa'i thang chen brgal bar shog /rnam gnyis bden pa zung 'jug tshong zong gis// rnam mang yon tan gyis 'byor rab dga' sogs// rnam mang 'gro ba'i don du mngon bsgrubs nas// rnam 'phrul phrin las skad cig gcig ston shog /sngon byon rgyal bas ma bsgral srid pa'i mtshor// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rlabs kyis rnam g.yengs pa'i// yid can chos kyi dpyangs thag la brten nas// gtan bde'i khang bzangs 'dren pa nyid gyur cig /sbyin bdag gis mtshon ris bral sems can rnams// nad med ring 'tsho phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal// dge ba'i pho nyas rdzogs ldan skal ba bzang*// 'di na yongs su bos bzhin 'phel gyur cig /ces rgyal ba'i bka' lung bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyis mtshon pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa la sogs pa sgo gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba bsags pa thams cad byang chub kyi rgyur smin pa'i bsngo smon dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba 'di ni rga zhe'u mdo'i blo ldan chos skyong dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed lo'i khrums zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ gang zhig blo yi rtsig logs yangs pa'i gzhir// dad gsum pir gyi zlos gar bsgyur nas ni// che ba'i yon tan bsams kyin gsol btab pas// mngon 'dod snye ma g.yur za dkon mchog gsum// blo gtad mi bslu nges pa gtam gyi rnga// srid gsum khongs su ches ldir bden pa'i mthus// 'di na dge ba bla med byang chub rgyur// yongs bsngos 'bras bu smin par byin gyis rlobs// dge slong phrin las bstan 'dzin zhes bgyi bas// gtan gyi skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum bzung zhing*// rang nyid skal ba mi dman snod nang du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i skal ba blang ched du// bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi che ba'i dpal// ngo mtshar legs ston bskal pa bzang po dang*// mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor rgyal ba'i yum// stong phrag brgya pa glegs bam nyi ma'i grangs// gtong phod chen pos mngon bsgrubs dge bas mtshon// lam bzang thos bsams bsgoms byung dge ba dang*// dkon mchog mchod dang sdug phongs sbyin gtong sogs// sgo gsum dang 'brel dge ba bgyis so cog /mkha' dang mnyam nyid song ba'i sems can khams// sdug bsngal mi bzad na kra'i mche rnon dbal// gzings pa 'khor ba'i mtsho las 'don pa'i mchog /rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// go 'phang mchog de mngon du gyur gyi bar// yang srid mtho ris rten gyi sdong bu'i rtser// 'jam dpal mkhyen pa'i 'od brgyas blo gros kyi// 'dab stong gzhung lugs phyogs su phye gyur cig /chos spyan rnam par yangs ldan 'dren pa yis// rgyal bstan dri med rjes su legs 'khrid cing*// bslab gsum rgyud bsdams tsan+da na yi bsung*// srid pa'i gdung 'phrog ring du 'phro bar shog

/chos tshul rab 'byams thos pa'i rna ba yangs// bsam bsgom rtun pa rmad byung lhur len pas// mtha' klas shes bya'i de nyid rig pa'i blos// legs bshad mi zad snang chen 'gyed par shog /ston pas rang bstan 'dzin par lung bstan gyi// gling bu srid pa'i rnar snyan e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog lung dang rig pa man ngag gis// yid ches lan brgyar bsgrubs pa rgyas byed shog /de tshul smra ba'i ro 'dzin ches bde ba'i// ngur smrig 'chang mchog 'dus pa'i khur chen gyis// bshad sgrub sgra dbyangs snyan pos phyogs bral gyi// nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor khyab par mdzes gyur cig /de mthus yul gru des mtshon 'jig rten khams// nad rims bgegs dang dus min 'chi ba'i mun// dkon mchog thugs rje'i nyi mas ring bsal nas// bde dga' rgya mtsho'i ro la rtsen gyur cig /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang*// bstan srung rnams kyi dpag yas mthu nus kyis// lhag bsam dge bas ji skad smon pa'i lam// grub pa'i bkra shis nyi ma brgya 'bar shog /ces mdo sde bskal pa bzang po dang rgyal yum stong phrag brgya pa bzhengs pas mtshon pa'i dge tshogs bsags pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa skal bzang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rga zhe'u mdo'i dge slong phrin las bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rab byung 'dod pa'i me byi lo'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum par sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// sarba ar+tha sid+dhir+bha wa tu/ rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i zla gzhon zer// reg pa'i 'phral la phan bde'i 'dab stong tshal// rgya cher bzhad pas srid gsum mdzes byed pa// nyi ma'i gnyen sogs rgyal kun spyi bos btud// gang la brten nas khams gsum sgrib sbyangs shing*// dge legs yon tan myu gu'i phreng ba bskyed// mngon mtho nges legs snye ma g.yur za ba'i// dge ba sum ldan chos la lam du bgyi// gzhan don khur khyer mu med zhing bzhugs pa'i// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob kun dang zag zad kyi// nyan thos 'phags tshogs lam gyi grogs su gzung*// deng 'dir rga lung sad kyi 'dus tshogs spyis// skyabs gsum nor bu gtsug tu gus bsten cing*// nges legs theg pa'i sgrub pa lhur len pas// shākya'i sras kyi spyod rjes bsgrub pa'i phyir// bka' lung gangs can brda ru 'gyur ro 'tshal// mi phyed dad gsum lang tsho ches bdo zhing*// dbyig gi gtong bod mi dman lag brkyangs te// mngon par bsgrubs pa'i legs byas zla ba dkar// sbyin bdag ltos 'khor bcas pa'i mar gyur 'gros// skye bar bsags pa'i sgrib gnyis mun bcil nas// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho ches cher rgyas pa dang*// byang chen kun+da'i dga' tshal rgyas par shog

/re zhig byang chub ma thob de srid kyi// skye bar dal 'byor rten ldan mtho ris kyi// yon tan bdun ldan 'dren mchog bla ma yis// rgyal bstan dri med rjes su khrid par shog /legs gsungs 'dul ba mdo dang sngags gzhung gi /thos pa'i rna lung yangs pas bsam bsgom gyis// rdul bral ye shes snang ba'i mig thob nas// rgya chen chos kyi snang chen 'gyed par shog /dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes mi bslu ba'i// bden tshig rnga chen srid pa gsum ldir bas// 'phrin yig dam pas ji ltar smon pa'i don// gegs bral nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes rga lung sad kyi chos sde'i 'dus tshogs thun mong nas rgyal ba'i bka' lung 'gyur ro 'tshal bsod nams kyi zhing du bsgrubs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam mdor bsdus 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
